newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Bank of Cyprus 97 Q1 op. profit up 2.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Cyprus 97 Q1 op. profit up 2.6 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Cyprus on Wednesday announced a 2.6 percent increase in its operating profit to 7.9 million Cyprus pounds ($15.5 million) in the first quarter of 1997 compared to the first quarter of 1996.
The operating profit was calculated before provisions for bad or doubtful debts. Operating profit in the first quarter of 1996 was 7.7 million Cyprus pounds.
"As regards the whole of 1997 the results of the group are expected to show about the same growth as that of the first quarter," the bank said. ($=0.508 pounds)
